intervention.description: ad-pacer 1.7.0 rolled out for the DE and FR budget lines (faster intraday pacing)

factual.sql:
WITH t0 AS (SELECT ts, SUM(planned_spend) AS den FROM fact_ad_plan_hourly WHERE (TRUE) AND (ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 18:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-20 23:00:00') GROUP BY ts), t1 AS (SELECT ts, SUM(ad_spend) AS num FROM fact_ads_hourly WHERE (TRUE) AND (ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 18:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-20 23:00:00') GROUP BY ts)
SELECT ts, den, num FROM t0 JOIN t1 USING (ts) ORDER BY ts
